name: YouTube Transcript + YouTube Search MCP
description: YouTube transcripts, video/channel search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for AI agents, via the hosted getyoutubetranscript.com MCP server. API-key or OAuth auth, free tier, no card required.
author: TubeAgentKit

tools.name: get_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a YouTube video link or ID, or asks to summarize, explain, quote, translate, take notes on, or chat about a specific YouTube video, lecture, podcast, or talk. Returns the full spoken text (captions) as one block, plus the title and channel. Set timestamps to true when the user wants timestamps, wants to find or quote where something is said, or wants a timeline or chapter breakdown: each caption line then starts with its [m:ss] time. Accepts watch, youtu.be, Shorts, and live URLs. Do not use for non-YouTube videos or for files the user uploads. If a video has no captions, this returns an error: tell the user instead of guessing what the video says.

video_url.description: YouTube URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID

send_metadata.description: Include title/author/thumbnail metadata. Defaults to true.

timestamps.description: One line per caption, each starting with its [m:ss] start time. Defaults to false (one block of text).

tools.name: get_transcript_languages
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which caption or subtitle languages a YouTube video has, or before requesting a transcript in a non-English language when you don't know whether the video offers it. Returns each language with its code (pass it as `language` to get_youtube_transcript), whether it is creator-uploaded or auto-generated, and the default language. An empty list means the video has captions turned off. Costs 1 credit. Not needed for an ordinary transcript request: get_youtube_transcript already reports which language it returned.

video_url.description: YouTube URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find YouTube videos or channels on a topic, for example 'find lectures on linear algebra' or 'popular videos about the Apollo missions', before reading or comparing them. Returns each result's title, video ID, link, channel, views, length, and upload date. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page. Does not return what a video says: call get_youtube_transcript with a result's video ID for that.

query.description: Search query. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page. Do not construct this yourself.

tools.name: get_channel_latest_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a YouTube channel has posted recently, or wants a channel's details (name, handle, description, subscribers) with its 15 newest uploads. Accepts an @handle, channel URL, or UC... ID. For a channel's full upload history use list_channel_videos; to find a topic inside one channel use search_channel_videos.

tools.name: search_channel_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants videos from one specific YouTube channel about a topic, for example 'what has @hubermanlab said about sleep' or 'find the MIT OpenCourseWare videos on recursion'. Searches only inside that channel. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

channel.description: Channel @handle, URL, or UC... id. Required unless `continuation` is set.

query.description: Query to search within the channel. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page.

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to browse a YouTube channel's uploads beyond its latest videos, for example to see a creator's older episodes, its most popular videos, its Shorts, or its past live streams. Returns the channel's uploads one page at a time. `tab` picks Videos (default), Shorts or Live; `sort` picks latest (default), popular or oldest. Both apply to the first page only. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

channel.description: Channel @handle, URL, or UC... id. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page.

tools.name: list_channel_playlists
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see the playlists a YouTube channel has published, for example a creator's course series or show seasons. Returns each playlist's id, title, link and video count, one page at a time. Pass a playlist's id to list_playlist_videos to see its videos. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

channel.description: Channel @handle, URL, or UC... id. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page.

tools.name: list_channel_posts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a YouTube channel's community posts: announcements, polls and updates a creator posts outside of videos. Returns each post's text, links, likes, comments and attached image, one page at a time. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

channel.description: Channel @handle, URL, or UC... id. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page.

tools.name: get_related_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants videos similar to one they shared, or asks 'what else should I watch' after a video. Returns the videos YouTube suggests next to it, each with title, video ID, link, channel, views, age and length. Pass a result's video ID to get_youtube_transcript for what it says.

video_url.description: YouTube URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID

tools.name: get_channel_banner
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a YouTube channel's banner or profile picture, for example to download the artwork or check how a channel presents itself. Accepts an @handle, channel URL, or UC... ID. Returns the uncropped banner URL, every crop size YouTube serves, and the avatar; has_banner is false when the channel has none.

tools.name: get_video_dislikes
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many dislikes a YouTube video has, or how well liked it is. YouTube no longer publishes dislikes, so this returns estimates from Return YouTube Dislike: likes, dislikes, a star rating and the view count. Say that the numbers are estimates.

video_url.description: YouTube URL (full or short) or an 11-character video ID

tools.name: list_playlist_videos
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a YouTube playlist, or wants to work through a course, lecture series, or podcast playlist video by video (for example to build study notes for each lecture). Returns the videos in playlist order, one page at a time. Pass `continuation` from a previous response for the next page.

playlist.description: Playlist URL or id. Required unless `continuation` is set.

continuation.description: Opaque token from a previous response - fetches the next page.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how many credits their getyoutubetranscript.com account has left, or after another tool reports the account has no credits remaining. Returns plan and top-up credit balances. Calling it does not use credits.
